rows.abstract: Seeks to ensure further the well-being of our womenfolk by PENALIZING MOTHERS who tolereate the commission of incestous rape, with 20 to 40 years imprisonment and a fine of P20,000.00 to P40,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-10-25

rows.author: A102
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE IMPOSITION OF INTEREST RATES ON LOANS GRANTED TO SMALL BORROWERS BY PAWNSHOPS, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 114, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PAWNSHOP REGULATION ACT
rows.abstract: Declares the following --- "NO PAWNSHOP, PAWNBROKER OR PAWNBROKER'S AGENT SHALL DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY STIPULATE, CHARGE, DEMAND, TAKE OR RECEIVE ANY HIGHER RATE OR GREATER SUM OR VALUE FOR ANY LOAN OR FORBEARANCE THAN SIX (6%) CENTUM PER ANNUM MONTH WHEN THE SUM LENT IT LESS THAN TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00); SEVEN (7%) CEN TUM PER ANNUM WHEN THE SUM IS MORE THAN TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00) BUT NOT MORE THAN FIVE THOUSAND PESOS (P5,000.00); AND NINE (9%) PER CENTUM (7%) PER ANNUM IF THE SUM IS MORE THAN FIVE THOUSAND PESOS (P5,000.00)." States that it shall be unlawful for a pawnshop, pawnbroker to divide the pawn offered by a person into two (2) or more fractions in order to collect a bigger interest than what is authorized.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1995-10-25

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT A SUBJECT ON FILIPINO VALUES AND VIRTUES BE TAUGHT AND INCORPORATED IN THE SCHOOL CURRICULA IN ALL PUBLIC AND PRIVATE ELEMENTARY, SECONDARY SCHOOLS AND COLLEGES

rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING A FORMAL BACCALAUREATE DEGREE FOR ALL MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SIXTY-NINE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990'
rows.abstract: Aims to professionalize the PNP personnel by requiring a formal baccalaureate degree for all applicants to the PNP; requires those already in service but do not possess said degree upon approval of this Act to comply within five (5) years from effectivity of this proposed measure.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10089

rows.author: A048
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE BRANCHES OF REGIONAL TRIAL COURTS (RTC) IN URBAN CENTERS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Substantiates the constitutional mandate that every person has the right to a speedy disposition of his case(s) before the courts; directs the Supreme Court to determine within six (6) months from approval of this Act the number of branches and places where the courts are to be established.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-10-25

rows.author: A077
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROCLAMATION OF THE CANDIDATE TO A LOCAL ELECTIVE POSITION IN A LOCAL ELECTION WHO OBTAINED THE SECOND HIGHEST NUMBER OF VOTES UPON THE FINALITY OF THE DECISION ISSUED BEFORE THE DAY OF ELECTION BY THE COMMISSION ON ELECTION (COMELEC) OR THE COURT OF COMPETENT JUIRISDICTION THAT THE CANDIDATE WHO OBTAINED THE HIGHEST NUMBER OF VOTES WAS DISQUALIFIED OR DECLARED NOT QUALIFIED FOR THE POSITION FOR WHATEVER REASON
rows.abstract: Seeks to remedy the situation of putting into office a person elected for another office, a situation supported by the doctrine of "plurality of votes." Provides, therefore, that --- "SECTION 1. Any provision of law to the contrary notwitstanding, the candidate in a local election to a local elective position who obtained the second highest number of votes shall be proclaimed upon the finality of a decision issued before the day of election by the Commission on Elections or any court of competent jurisdiction that the candidate who obtained the highest number of votes was disqualified or declared not qualified as candidate for the position for whatever cause.
rows.status: Substituted by HB01890
